description: Search the live web and get ranked results with title, URL, snippet and published date. When to use: an agent needs current facts, news or links that are not on chain - 'what is the BTC fee market saying today', 'recent Zcash governance proposals', 'find the docs page for X'. Use it before web_fetch, then fetch the one URL that looks authoritative. Do not use: for on-chain facts (use the BTC/ETH/XMR/ZEC/TRON tools) or for content inside a CyberLibrary book (use cyberlibrary_fulltext_search). Provider: self-hosted SearXNG (Bing/Baidu/360/Sogou/Yandex/Marginalia) first, then Serper, Tavily and cn.bing RSS as automatic fallbacks. Returns: {query, count, results:[{title,url,snippet,published}], provider (serper|tavily|bing_rss), cached, took_ms, _metering}. Results may be cached for up to 10 minutes; a cached result still counts as one call against the free allowance. Metered: all ten web tools share 100 free calls/day per IP (separate from the risk/library allowance), then 1 credit per call over x402 - there is no API key; the 402 answer carries accepts[]. max count is 10.

count.description: Number of results to return, 1-10. Default 5.

lang.description: Optional language preference, e.g. zh-cn or en.

site.description: Optional: restrict results to one domain, e.g. github.com.

name: web_search
title: Web Search
